CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION

  Regular Meeting
  April 5, 2021

  Absent:  None

  Vice President Garcia arrived at 7:05 PM

  Quyle, Associate Planner, Mario Arellano, Assistant Planner, and Erica

ITEM 3:  RESIDENTIAL PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT RP-19-09
  • 119 South Curtis Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Residential Planned Development
  Permit to construct a 2-story addition totaling 880 square feet to an
  existing 2,012 square foot two-story single-family home located in the
  R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone. The proposed project will also
  construct an attached 4-car garage to the rear and eliminate an existing
  two-car garage.
  • Recommended Action: Pending public testimony, adopt Resolution
  No. 21-02, approving Residential Planned Development Permit RP-
  19-09, subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  • Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided staff presentation.
  • Public Comments: There were none.
  • Commissioner Comments:
  3
  04/05/2021
   Several Commissioners had concerns with the intended use of the
  home as the home has many bathrooms, bedrooms, and two kitchens.
  Commissioners also had concerns that the applicant was not present
  for the meeting and therefore, could not have all their concerns
  addressed.
  Commissioner Messina had concerns with the building’s box like
  structure.
  Commissioner Wang clarified the reason for this type of project
  appearing at the Planning Commission whereas if the property was
  zoned R-1 then it would not.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Residential Planned Development Permit RP-19-09 to
  the April 19, 2021 Planning Commission meeting so the applicant can be
  present to answer some of the Commissioner’s concerns.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Messina. Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-2
  Ayes:  Ho, Messina, Olson, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Garcia,
  Gardea,
  Noes:  Pham, Wang
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 4:  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP 083279 AND PLANNED DEVELOPMENT
  PERMIT PD-20-11
  • 209 North Monterey Street
  • Request: This is an application for a Tentative Tract Map TT 083279
  and Planned Development Permit PD-20-11 to construct a 10,494
  square foot, nine (9) unit residential condominium complex on a site
  of approximately 17,800 square feet located in the R-3 (Multiple
  Family Residential) zone, for a property located at 209 North Monterey
  Street in the City of Alhambra.
  • Recommended Action: Pending public testimony, adopt Resolution
  No. 21-09, approving Tentative Tract Map TT 083279 and Planned
  Development Permit PD-20-11, subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  • Assistant Planner Mario Arellano provided staff presentation.
  4
  04/05/2021
   •  Public Comments: There were none.
  •  Commissioner Comments:
  Commissioner Sahu verified this was the first development subject to
  the Inclusionary Housing Ordinance (“IHO”) to come before the
  Commission. He also inquired about the amount of the in-lieu fee
  payment. Some Commissioners expressed concern that the in-lieu fee
  amount was low.
  Commissioners Tang and Messina paid compliments to the project
  design.
  Commissioner Tsujii inquired about the purpose of the Public Works
  Department’s street dedication requirement.
  President Gardea and Commissioner Ho commented on the project
  landscaping.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Tentative Tract Map TT 083279 and Planned
  Development Permit PD-20-11.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Tang. Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-1

  Ayes:  Ho, Messina, Olson, Pham, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  Sahu
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 5:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-32 AND CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT CUP-20-07
  • 29 South Electric Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit PD-
  20-32 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-07 to construct an 11,895
  square foot, two (2) story school building on a site of approximately
  4.17 acres located in the CPD (Commercial Planned Development), R-
  3 (Multiple-Family Residential) zone, AC (Automobile Commercial)
  overlay district zone, for a property located at 29 Electric Avenue in
  the City of Alhambra.
  5
  04/05/2021
 •  Recommended Action: Pending public testimony, adopt Resolution
  No. 21-10, approving Planned Development Permit PD-20-32 and
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-07, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
•  Assistant Planner Mario Arellano provided staff presentation.
•  Public Comments: There were none.
•  Commissioner Comments:
  Commissioner Messina stated that she was familiar with the school
  and that the school was in need of additional classroom space.
  Commissioner Olson noted a correction needed to Section 1E of the
  Resolution regarding the Design Review Board status.
  Commissioner Tang commented on the building siting, potential
  privacy issues with the neighbors, the need for additional landscaping,
  and the loss of a basketball court.
  Commissioner Wang questioned the adequacy of the drop-off/pick-
  up area, inquired on the type of construction, and commented on the
  lack of outdoor seating areas.
  Commissioner Tsujii inquired if the new building was for existing
  students or if it was to accommodate increased enrollment. He also
  commented on the adequacy of the drop-off/pick-up area and asked if
  there was any queuing analysis prepared.
  Commissioner Messina provided background information regarding
  the school’s needs.
  Carrie Fuller, School Principal, answered the Commission’s
  questions regarding student/enrollment levels.
  Commissioner Olson commented that any traffic controls on
  Acacia/Electric would be helpful.
  Robert Kerr, Applicant and Project Architect, addressed
  Commissioner questions regarding drop-off/pick-up, parking,
  playground amenities, landscaping, and outdoor seating.
  Commissioner Ho further verified with Mr. Kerr matters of the drop-
  off/pick-up area, and the usage of the parking lot/playground by the
  school and the church.
  Commissioner Tsujii asked if there were any complaints about
  queuing on Acacia. Staff replied there were none to Staff’s knowledge.
  Commissioner Tang wanted to see the side yard landscaping be
  extended to the front of the building, questioned if there was adequate
  outdoor space for seating amenities, questioned if there could be more
  landscaping on the north side of the building, and commented on the
  need for playground space.
  President Gardea discussed with Mr. Kerr drop-off/pick-up
  alternatives.
  Commissioner Sahu raised the question of a possible underground
  parking level.
  Commissioner Messina stated that the school is limited and does not
  possess the luxuries and flexibilities of other schools.

  6
  04/05/2021
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Planned Development Permit PD-20-32 and
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-07.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu. Seconded by Commissioner Messina.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-1

  Ayes:  Ho, Messina, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  Tang
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None
